MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The capacitor assortment fits the circuit-building work suggested by my breadboards, PCB supplies, and relay module; it would give me components to use with those supplies.",
    "The component tester would help me identify and check parts while assembling circuits, and the multicolor heat shrink would help insulate and distinguish wiring connections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The filament and dial indicator holder require activities or equipment my purchases do not indicate I use.",
    "Fast-blinking LEDs have a specific lighting effect I do not currently need, while the nut assortment and adhesive activator lack a clear connection to a project I am working on.",
    "The black heat shrink is useful, but I would choose the multicolor kit instead; I do not need both. The resistor assortment also fits my interests without being something I need to buy now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on projects seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for 3D printing and precision measuring accessories.",
    "Having bought LEDs and fasteners does not mean I currently want specialized lighting effects or adhesive supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases work together for circuit assembly, so items that help connect, insulate, or check those circuits have a clearer purpose for me.",
    "I choose supplies when they solve a concrete need; a related item or a large assortment is not automatically a purchase I would make now.",
    "Similar products can fill the same need, and the colored heat shrink gives me a practical reason to choose it over the black assortment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my circuit-building interests but stretched them into unrelated workshop needs and purchases without a current purpose."
}
